package nats

import (
	"context"
	"log"

	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// InProcessSubscriber consumes the internal taskAnswer.inprocess command.
type InProcessSubscriber struct {
	Conn    *natsgo.Conn
	Subject string
	Queue   string
	Handler func(ctx context.Context, payload []byte, headers map[string]string) error
}

// Subscribe registers queue subscription and exposes message headers to the handler.
func (s InProcessSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.Conn == nil {
		return nil
	}
	_, err := s.Conn.QueueSubscribe(s.Subject, s.Queue, func(msg *natsgo.Msg) {
		headers := map[string]string{}
		for key, values := range msg.Header {
			if len(values) > 0 {
				headers[key] = values[0]
			}
		}
		if err := s.Handler(ctx, msg.Data, headers); err != nil {
			log.Printf("inprocess handler error: %v", err)
		}
	})
	return err
}
